note: Depot palette. Streams and service levels are Okabe-Ito based so they stay distinguishable under deuteranopia, protanopia and tritanopia. Garbage is a deep navy (#1F3A93), not the lid red: red and green lids are the pair colour-blind readers confuse most. Its minimum CIELAB difference from the other three streams is 37 or more under deuteranopia, protanopia and tritanopia, against 20 for the old slate grey. Quantities use ColorBrewer single-hue ramps, light = low, dark = high. Must match the tokens in css/style.css.
source: Okabe M and Ito K, Color Universal Design (2008); Brewer C, ColorBrewer 2.0
